english.title: Fail to declare goods obtained in the United Kingdom
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to declare goods, namely **(..SPECIFY..)

(A)_[carried with him]_
(B)_[carried with her]_
(C)_[contained in his baggage]_
(D)_[contained in her baggage]_

which, being dutiable goods or chargeable goods,

(E)_[he]_
(F)_[she]_

had obtained in the United Kingdom without payment of duty or tax and for which

(G)_[he]_
(H)_[she]_

was not entitled to exemption from duty or tax
english.legislation: Contrary to section 78(1) and (3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fail to declare goods
carried with him/her OR
contained in their baggage
which he/she had obtained
in UK and had not paid duty/tax
and was not entitled to exemption from that duty/tax

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the purposes of this section, anything carried by the person means carried by sea, air or train and includes clothing worn by the person.
(ii) THIS IS AN ABSOLUTE OFFENCE - therefore an offence is committed when a person fails to declare goods to which no exemption applies.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions.
(iv) Section 61 was amended by Schedule 7 to the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2020, brought into force on the 31st December 2020 by SI 2020/1642. For any offences committed on or after the 31st December 2020, see offence wording document H100300 (CJS code CE79383).

other.penalty:
Three times the value of the thing not declared or of a fine of level three on the standard scale, whichever is the greater.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
